manifest.counting_policy: file_count/total_bytes describe payload files; manifest is excluded to avoid a self-hash cycle. Archive has file_count + 1 regular members. repository_inputs are supplied by the signed tag, not duplicated in the archive.

closure_method: Successful instrumented execution of both validators, including synchronous/URL/asynchronous reads and child contract-dump processes, plus present optional file probes, plus direct publication references and final review PNGs/contact sheets/manifests/measurement programs. Fresh tag+archive verification is required.
exclusions: old failed captures outside required current source-navigation authority
signature_boundary: The original signed tag authenticates its Git tree and recorded evidence hashes. This later descriptor pins the archive and manifest, without moving or resigning the acceptance tag.
evidence_path_semantics: Existing repository-relative evidence paths resolve in the signed-tag checkout plus archive overlay; they do not imply that each evidence file is tracked in maintained develop.

verification_prerequisites.browser_execution: Anonymous Chromium contract dumping only, no page/session/capture; Firefox/WebKit versions are read from pinned Playwright registry.
verification_prerequisites.dependency_source: Standard tool prerequisites. The recorded proof uses independent copies of installed exact-version packages, not original worktree evidence.
verification_prerequisites.namespace: Linux user+mount+network namespaces; clean checkout and tooling mounted read-only at recorded path.
